response: Urologie is the medical specialty that deals with the diagnosis, treatment, and prevention of diseases affecting the urinary system. It includes the study of the anatomy, physiology, and pathology of the urinary tract, as well as the diagnosis and treatment of conditions such as urinary tract infections, kidney stones, and urinary tract disorders. Urologists are medical doctors who specialize in treating patients with urinary tract conditions and are often involved in the diagnosis and treatment of kidney diseases.
